00046 DiskInUGenInternal::DiskInUGenInternal(File const& file, 
00047                      const int numChannels, 
00048                      bool loopFlag, 
00049                      const double startTime, 
00050                      const int numFrames,
00051                      const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00052 : ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(0, numChannels - 1),
00053   file_(file),
00054   loopFlag_(loopFlag),
00055   startTime_(startTime < 0.0 ? 0.0 : startTime),
00056   doneAction_(doneAction),
00057   shouldDeleteValue(doneAction_ == UGen::DeleteWhenDone)
00058 { 
00059   ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00060   ugen_assert(startTime == startTime_);
00061   ugen_assert(numFrames > 0);
00062   
00063   bufferData = new float*[numChannels];
00064   
00065   filePlayer.addChangeListener(this);
00066   filePlayer.setFile(file, numFrames);
00067   filePlayer.prepareToPlay(UGen::getEstimatedBlockSize(), UGen::getSampleRate());
00068   
00069   filePlayer.setPosition(startTime);
00070   filePlayer.start();
00071 }
00072 
00073 DiskInUGenInternal::~DiskInUGenInternal() throw()
00074 {
00075   filePlayer.releaseResources();
00076   filePlayer.removeChangeListener(this);
00077   
00078   delete [] bufferData;
00079 }

00081 void DiskInUGenInternal::prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00082 {
00083   senderUserData = userData;
00084   if(isDone()) sendDoneInternal();
00085 }
00086 
00087 void DiskInUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00088 {
00089   int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00090   int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00091   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00092   {
00093     bufferData[i] = proxies[i]->getSampleData();
00094   }
00095   
00096   AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, numChannels, blockSize);
00097   
00098   AudioSourceChannelInfo info;
00099   info.buffer     = &audioSampleBuffer;
00100   info.numSamples   = blockSize;
00101   info.startSample  = 0;
00102   
00103   if(filePlayer.isPlaying())
00104     filePlayer.getNextAudioBlock(info);
00105   else
00106     info.clearActiveBufferRegion();
00107   
00108   if(isDone())
00109   {
00110     shouldDelete = shouldDelete ? true : shouldDeleteValue;
00111   }
00112 }
00113 
00114 void DiskInUGenInternal::changeListenerCallback (ChangeBroadcaster*)
00115 {
00116   if(filePlayer.isPlaying() == false)
00117   {
00118     if(loopFlag_ == true)
00119     {
00120       filePlayer.setPosition(startTime_);
00121       filePlayer.start();
00122     }
00123     else
00124     {
00125       if(shouldDeleteValue)
00126         setIsDone();
00127     }
00128   }
00129   
00130 }

00171 
00172 void DiskIn::initWithJuceFile(File const& file, 
00173                 bool loopFlag, 
00174                 const double startTime, 
00175                 const int numFrames,
00176                 const UGen::DoneAction doneAction) throw()
00177 {
00178   AudioFormatManager formatManager;
00179   formatManager.registerBasicFormats();
00180   
00181   AudioFormatReader* reader = formatManager.createReaderFor (file);
00182   int numChannels = reader->numChannels;
00183   delete reader;
00184   
00185   initInternal(numChannels);
00186   generateFromProxyOwner(new DiskInUGenInternal(file, 
00187                           numChannels, 
00188                           loopFlag, 
00189                           startTime, 
00190                           numFrames, 
00191                           doneAction)); 
00192 }
